description: Check the current user's account status, billing, and usage. Returns plan info, API call count, the amount consumed this billing cycle in USD (amount_consumed_this_cycle_usd), the billing mode in effect (billing_mode), whether a credit card is on file, and any failed/pending payments. Use this to diagnose why API calls are blocked (missing card or failed payment). Requires the user's API key in the Authorization header.
name: account_status
